name: Express
description: A TypeScript Express (v5) API with Zod validation and a zod-to-openapi contract export.

specSections.title: API Contract & Error Codes
specSections.guidance: List every endpoint under /api with its method, route, operation ID (registered in openapi/registry.ts, which becomes the client method name), the Zod request and response schemas, the auth middleware (requireAuth, requirePermission) and ownership rule, and the status codes it returns. Give the error table: each UPPER_SNAKE errorCode, its HTTP status and when it applies; errors are application/problem+json with errorCode, and Zod validation errors are 400 with an errors map. Name the auth scheme (session cookies for same-origin, bearer JWT for cross-origin) and the health endpoints /api/health/live and /api/health/ready.

order.reason: Change the contract (backend/openapi/api.json) before regenerating the frontend client from it.

generatedFiles.ciCheck: cd {be} && npm run openapi:export && git diff --exit-code openapi/api.json

requiredEnv.description: The database URI (postgresql://…), read directly by lib/config.ts and the data client; sslmode=require for managed hosts.
Comma-separated frontend origins the cors middleware allows (cross-origin model only).

checklist.item: createApp takes its dependencies (DB client, clock), routers are thin, and domain rules are pure functions tested by FR.
Zod validates every input and handlers return DTOs, never ORM rows.
The error middleware returns application/problem+json with the spec's errorCodes, and unknown errors return a generic 500.
helmet, request logging and rate limits on auth routes are set; x-powered-by is disabled.
requireAuth/requirePermission plus ownership checks protect every protected route; cors is only used for cross-origin with explicit origins.
Config is parsed with Zod at startup and fails fast; no secrets are committed.
Integration tests cover success, 400, 401, 403, 404, each errorCode and 409 per FR.
The contract is exported from the same Zod schemas, openapi/api.json is fresh (CI check), and the gate passes.

gate: cd {be} && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
cd {be} && npm run openapi:export && git diff --exit-code openapi/api.json
